title: EMOGen: Enhancing Mask Optimization via Pattern Generation
problem: Existing layout pattern generation methods target optical proximity correction (OPC) improvement but are not explicitly trained for OPC nor integrated into OPC methods, limiting their practical effectiveness in semiconductor manufacturing.
motivation: Layout pattern generation via deep generative models is essential for building large-scale pattern libraries in semiconductor fabrication.
method: EMOGen enables co-evolution between layout pattern generation using deep generative models and learning-based OPC methods. The two optimization processes iteratively enhance each other through the co-evolutionary framework, enabling mutual improvement in pattern quality and correction performance.
key_novelty: Co-evolutionary methodology that jointly optimizes pattern generation and OPC methods to improve both simultaneously rather than optimizing them separately.
contributions: EMOGen framework for co-evolution of layout pattern generation and OPC
primary_theme: Co-evolutionary optimization of layout patterns and OPC
